name: せいぎの にんじんシャワー
note: せいぎの にんじんシャワー cast (うさひめ), facing RIGHT (mirror for left). Play 0->1->2, hold 2 until the shots have left, then 3, then return to usahime.png. fxSpawn = sprite-local pixel (frame coords) at the nose tip where the shots start; mirror x (31-x) when facing left.

frames.name: attack_0
frames.desc: windup: crouches back 1px and squashes 1px (aiming the carrot shower)

frames.name: attack_1
frames.desc: release: springs forward 1px and up 1px, stretched - FIRE the shots from the nose

frames.name: attack_2
frames.desc: hold: stays 1px forward while the carrots fly

frames.name: attack_3
frames.desc: recovery: back in place (next: standing sprite)
